نتوادع (form VI)
# نَتَوَادَعُ (natawādaʕu) /na.ta.waː.da.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
# نَتَوَادَعَ (natawādaʕa) /na.ta.waː.da.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
# نَتَوَادَعْ (natawādaʕ) /na.ta.waː.daʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
